transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess I’m here because I’m just… tired all the time. Even if I’m in bed all night, I wake up feeling heavy, like everything takes too much effort. Work, laundry—basic things feel like a lot.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… most days, I think. I wake up with this heavy, kind of flat feeling in my chest. Sometimes I just sit at the kitchen table and stare out at the yard and… it feels like there isn’t really a good version of the future coming.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to make time for hiking, yoga, messing with my garden… taking bird photos. Lately I just cancel things or don’t bother. My camera’s been sitting in the closet. It all just feels like too much effort.
How long have you been feeling this down most days?
Most days? I’d say… about two months now. Maybe a little hard to pin down, but around that.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I don’t know… my sleep’s kind of all over the place. I haven’t really been keeping track.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
Yeah… sometimes. Mostly late at night I get this thought that maybe my husband would be better off without me. I haven’t made any kind of plan, but… it keeps coming back, and it scares me.
Are you thinking about killing yourself right now?
Not… right now, no. It’s more at night, when I start thinking my husband might be better off without me. I haven’t made a plan or anything, but the thought keeps coming back, and it scares me.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Yeah… I guess so. At work I’ll read the same survey results or a client email over and over and it just doesn’t stick. Even deciding which spreadsheet to start with can feel… weirdly hard.
Have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least a couple of weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had low stretches before, but I don’t know if they lasted that long or were like this.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?
I don’t think so… not in any obvious way. I mean, some days I don’t really pay attention to it, but I haven’t noticed a big change.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah… my husband’s mentioned it. He says I kind of move around the house like I’m underwater. And if he asks me something simple, sometimes it takes me a bit to answer… like the words just come out really slow.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or high, needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah… maybe. After we signed the mortgage papers, for the first few weeks I felt kind of… wired, almost unstoppable. But it wasn’t all good. I’d get really irritated too, like snapping at my husband or people at work over stupid little delays.
During that time when you felt wired and unstoppable, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?
I’m not really sure. I remember sleeping less some nights, but I don’t know if I’d say I felt rested… it’s a little blurry.
During that wired, unstoppable time, were you doing a lot more activities or projects than usual?

Yeah… I guess I was. I couldn’t really sit still. I kept getting up to sketch out office layouts, reorganize files, start another little task… even when there wasn’t any real reason it had to be done right then.
During that wired, unstoppable time, did you feel more confident or powerful than usual?

Yeah… I did. I felt like I was… better than the people around me at work, I guess. Like I could leave and build my own consulting thing and it would take off, even though I didn’t really have clients lined up or anything.
About how many days did that wired, unstoppable period last?

It’s hard to pin down exactly… but I think it started after we took on the mortgage, maybe about two months ago. It was that overcharged push for a while, and then it kind of shifted into this low stretch.
Did that wired, overcharged period last at least 4 days in a row?
I think so, yeah. It wasn’t just a day or two. Since the mortgage thing a couple months ago, it went from that overcharged work push for a while… and then later it dropped into this low stretch.
Did that wired, overcharged period last at least 1 week in a row?
I’m not totally sure it was a full week straight. Since we took on the mortgage a couple months ago, it went from that overcharged business push… and then eventually into this low stretch.
During that overcharged period, did it cause major problems at work or at home?

Yeah… I guess it did. I’ve fallen behind on some client reports, and at home I’m mostly just doing the bare minimum. I’ve also kind of stopped seeing friends and doing the outdoor stuff that usually keeps me level. Most of my energy’s just going into getting through work and basic things.
During that wired, overcharged period, did your behavior create serious problems at work, at home, or socially?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t call it a disaster, but it did cause problems. I got behind on client reports, and I’ve been pulling back from friends and the outdoor stuff that usually helps me stay steady. At home it’s mostly just… getting the basics done.
